correctness.rationale: All-parameter PSD iff reciprocal-product inequality; strictly convex cost-target feasible set; complete KKT gives a unique positive scalar root; target minimum cost is continuous strictly monotone; global budget inversion and high-budget/two-price formulas follow analytically. The replayable verifier checks 100 full-matrix spectra, 100 separate numerical optimizers, 1280 support inequalities, 86 high-rate identities, 200 phase cases and 196 exact rational identities. No finite experiment is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The arbitrary independent-price two-group network allocation is a natural budgeted control gap, not a fixed slice or reparameterization. It gives a unique optimal gain vector for every budget, finite scalar root solves, price-prefix activation, single cheapest-node onset, an explicit terminal affine law and a closed price-ratio phase boundary. These motivate efficient actuator selection and exact sensitivity analysis on all complete bipartite sizes; existing generic SDP statements do not provide them.
